thread:
elaine-support: Hi team, legal just asked to place an ad-hoc preserve on customer org `org_9qx` — they want all objects that would be deleted by TTL or retention cutoff frozen immediately. Can ops/sre confirm if we can apply a temporary hold and what the timeline looks like?

omar-legal: Thanks — we received a subpoena requesting preservation for 45 days. Need confirmation that nothing will be purged during that window and an export of audit logs and KMS key access records. Priority: high.

jess-sre: Do we have an existing litigation-hold flow? My quick view: we support retention overrides per-customer via the retention service, but it usually goes through a PR and DB feature flag. Can we do an emergency flag?

mike-eng: We can set a per-org retention_override row that effectively sets TTL to "never". It requires a write to the retention config service and an immediate cache invalidation. I can do the change if legal signs off. Will need a short maintenance window (1–2min) to push and verify.

lisa-cs: Legal asked for evidence that deletions stopped and an exported list of objects and timestamps. They also want the audit log for any KMS/HSM key usage for the last 30 days.

support-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-1789, owner: jess-sre, severity: P1 — please update.

jess-sre: Ok I can own the hold. Mike, can you prepare the DB update and a small script to snapshot objects for org_9qx? I need a dry-run first to make sure we don't accidentally mutate other orgs.

mike-eng: Will do. Dry-run plan: 1) create retention_override org_9qx -> ttl=null (non-destructive flag) 2) run cache invalidation 3) list tombstone and active objects for org_9qx from indexer and storage 4) export to S3 with KMS encryption using key `redwood-prod-audit` 5) share presigned export link to legal. I'll post commands.

jess-sre: Sounds good. Important: do NOT rotate or rekey the HSM key during export window — legal wants key usage logs intact. Omar, can you confirm the legal text for the export?

omar-legal: Confirmed. We need: a) manifest of object ids + original TTL + last-modified + storage location b) operational audit logs showing delete attempts and responses c) KMS key ACL and usage logs for the last 30 days. Also include a signed chain-of-custody note.

elain e-support: (typo) Elaine: Updated — I will coordinate the chain-of-custody doc. Mike/Jess, please include the exact commands you run so we can hand to legal.

mike-eng: Dry-run commands (will run in staging first):
```bash
# create override (non-destructive flag)
curl -X POST https://retention.internal/api/v1/overrides -H "Authorization: Bearer $SYS_TOKEN" -d '{"org_id":"org_9qx","ttl":null,"reason":"legal_hold_subpoena_235"}'
# invalidate cache
curl -X POST https://cache.internal/invalidate -d '{"scope":"org","id":"org_9qx"}'
# list objects
python tools/list_org_objects.py --org org_9qx --output /tmp/org_9qx_manifest.json
```

jess-sre: After dry-run, run production with same steps but ensure to tag change in audit: `retention_override:created:by=mike-eng:ticket=INC-2026-1789`. I'll tail the deletions index to confirm no tombstone activity.

support-bot: Audit log export job queued: job_id=job-88f3, ETA ~12min.

lisa-cs: Legal also wants a note on whether KMS/HSM prevents us from producing encrypted archives. We have the key and can encrypt exports; HSM stores key material and we can produce usage logs.

omar-legal: Good. Once we have the manifest + audit + KMS logs, I'll review and send to the requester. For compliance, please keep all artifacts in the legal S3 bucket with `retention=indefinite` until we close.

jess-sre: Plan accepted. I'll run dry-run in 10m, post results, then we schedule prod push after legal ack.

elain e-support: (typo) Elaine: tagging legal for ack @omar-legal :point_up:

omar-legal: Ack — proceed with dry-run. Notify me when you start prod so I can timestamp chain-of-custody.

mike-eng: Starting dry-run in staging now, will update with manifest link when complete.

jess-sre: Thanks everyone. Please keep comms here and add any errors. If we observe unexpected delete attempts after override, escalate to eng-infra and ping me immediately.

support-bot: job-88f3 completed: manifest available at s3://redwood-legal-exports/dryrun/org_9qx_manifest.json

mike-eng: Dry-run manifest looks good, no deletions observed during override window. Ready for prod after legal ack.

omar-legal: Legal ack to proceed to prod push and official export.

jess-sre: Proceeding to prod in 5. Will post final export links and KMS usage logs when done.

mike-eng: Prod override applied, cache invalidated, export started. tag: retention_override:created:by=mike-eng:ticket=INC-2026-1789

support-bot: export job job-99a2 queued, ETA ~18min.

jess-sre: Verified no delete events during hold window in deletions index. KMS logs stream linked to export job.

lisa-cs: Uploaded chain-of-custody doc to legal S3 path and shared presigned link with Omar.

omar-legal: Received artifacts. Closing hold in 45 days per subpoena unless we receive further instructions. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
